country.name: Guyana
country.languagePolicy: English is the default interface language, not a substitute for a learner's home language. Indigenous language, culture and bilingual learning requirements are community-, people-, region- and institution-specific and require participation by the relevant Indigenous community; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Guyanese reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible Ministry, regional education authority, National Accreditation Council, Indigenous community, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: Guyana's Ministry of Education governs national school policy and curriculum through central and regional structures across ten administrative regions and Georgetown. Post-secondary and tertiary provider registration and accreditation are separate National Accreditation Council processes; the University of Guyana has its own statutory identity.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve school name, region or Georgetown district, locality, level, public or private status where published, source file and publication date, record status and review date. A downloaded list is a dated discovery source, not proof of current operation or every program.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Legal or statutory existence, National Accreditation Council registration, institutional accreditation, program accreditation, qualification ownership, awarding authority, professional recognition and protected institutional title are distinct claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education
authorities.role: national education policy, curriculum, school administration, education resources and statistics

authorities.name: Regional education departments and Georgetown education authority
authorities.role: regional school administration and implementation within their assigned competence

authorities.name: National Centre for Educational Resource Development
authorities.role: curriculum and educational resource development within the Ministry system

authorities.name: National Accreditation Council of Guyana
authorities.role: registration and accreditation of post-secondary and tertiary institutions, providers, courses, programs and awards within its statutory remit

authorities.name: University of Guyana
authorities.role: national university operating under its governing law and institutional authority

authorities.name: Council for Technical and Vocational Education and Training
authorities.role: TVET policy, standards and provider registration within its competence

authorities.name: Ministry of Amerindian Affairs and relevant village and community authorities
authorities.role: Indigenous rights, community governance, language and cultural participation

authorities.name: Childcare and Protection Agency and competent child-protection authorities

curriculum.authority: Ministry of Education and NCERD within their competences
curriculum.title: Guyana national curriculum, syllabuses and Ministry learning resources
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm level, grade, subject, curriculum or syllabus title, publication version, effective school year, regional implementation, institution context and applicable assessment or examining authority before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Ministry curriculum materials, CXC CSEC or CAPE syllabuses, TVET competency standards and external resources are different layers. CXC syllabuses and external materials must not silently replace the Guyana national curriculum, Ministry implementation guidance or community-specific Indigenous-language requirements.

schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: List of Schools by Georgetown and Regions 1–10
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The Ministry page provides downloadable school lists for Georgetown, Regions 1–10 and a total-schools file. A listing does not by itself prove current operation, authorization of every level or program, current ownership, or current contact information.
requiredRecordFields: public or private status when published
source file publication or update date

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display school year, publication or update date, measure, definition, unit of analysis, population, level, region, sector, source and filters. The latest school year visible in an archive must not be described as current without a newer official release or explicit confirmation.

higherEducation.recognitionAuthority: National Accreditation Council of Guyana and the responsible statutory or governmental authority according to the claim
higherEducation.accreditationAuthority: National Accreditation Council of Guyana or a separately identified competent accrediting body
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Registration with the National Accreditation Council is required for post-secondary or tertiary provision but is not institutional accreditation. Statutory establishment of the University of Guyana, provider registration, institutional accreditation, program accreditation, qualification ownership, awarding authority, professional recognition and protected institutional title are separate claims; each requires its own current certificate, register entry, law or decision and validity period.

privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Protection of Children Act 2009 (Act No. 17 of 2009)
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Commencement, regulations, appointment and current powers of the Data Protection Commissioner, lawful basis, notices, security, children's consent through a parent or guardian where applicable, best interests, safeguarding, incident response, cross-border transfers and institutional protocols require qualified Guyanese legal review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: The Constitution protects Indigenous peoples' languages, cultural heritage and way of life. English, Guyanese Creole, Wapichan and other Indigenous languages have different social and legal contexts. Language, orthography, culture, territory, curriculum and community governance must be reviewed with the relevant people, village and community; the Wapichan bilingual pilot must not be generalized to every Indigenous community.

completionCriteria: A qualified Guyanese education reviewer is named.
Ministry, regional, Georgetown, NAC, TVET, university, Indigenous-community and institution responsibilities are correctly assigned.
Every school record retains region or Georgetown district, level, sector where published, source-file publication date, current status and review date.
Every statistic shows school year, publication date, definition, population, level, region, sector and provenance.
Curriculum mappings identify level, grade, subject, curriculum or syllabus, version, effective year, examining authority and regional or community context.

Every higher-education claim distinguishes statutory existence, provider registration, institutional accreditation, program accreditation, qualification ownership, awarding authority, professional recognition and protected title.
Indigenous education and language requirements are reviewed with competent representatives of the relevant people, village and community.
Privacy, child-protection, Education Act, commencement, regulation and institutional obligations are reviewed by qualified Guyanese counsel.
Accessibility, safeguarding, low-bandwidth, offline, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, registration, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
